text:
sam: Quick intake from Sales — enterprise prospect wants a bundled integration deliverable. They asked for: Python SDK session persistence (long-lived chat sessions w/ transparent token refresh), Terraform module to provision Dedicated pools + VPC peering defaults, and a marketplace package/installer for easy onboarding. Can we triage?
lara: Customer is Acme (SaaS). Primary asks: 1) Python SDK should keep a session object alive for ~30m with auto-refresh, 2) terraform to create dedicated pool + network egress rules, 3) marketplace listing to show "Dedicated + Private" option. They made it a purchase blocker.
mike: @eng want to confirm acceptance criteria before we push to backlog. Propose ACs: 1) SDK Session API (Session.start/extend, refresh hook) + example notebook, 2) Terraform module with outputs for pool_id / peering_id + tests, 3) marketplace manifest + install script. Docs + 2 small samples.
anna: Technical notes from infra side: Python session persistence -> wrap auth + KV cache pointer, store short-lived refresh token flow. Should be ~3 dev-days for SDK PR + 2 days for tests. Terraform module to call our provisioning API + poll until ready — ~4 dev-days. Marketplace packaging depends on legal assets but packaging itself ~2 dev-days. Rough ETA: 2 sprints if prioritized.
barry: SRE checklist: Dedicated pool provisioning needs subnet tags + egress SG rules. We need a default NACL template and an onboarding checklist for customers to enable peering. Also need metric labels for customer_id and pool_id.
zoe: Prioritization request: This is a clear revenue blocker. Suggest tag: integ:customer-acme and backlog tag: "customer-integ-prio". Recommend we slot into next sprint for a scoped MVP: SDK session + terraform module (marketplace as follow-up). Target: ship MVP within 3 weeks if we allocate an eng + devex pair.
mike: devex asks: sample code snippet for docs. Proposed snippet:```python
from redwood import Session
s = Session(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
e = s.start(role="assistant", timeout=1800)
for chunk in e.stream(prompt):
    print(chunk)
# refresh handled transparently
```
lara: Sales follow-up: they also want SSO/SCIM connector guidance in marketplace docs — not a blocker for initial buy, but callout in the install flow would help.
anna: Engineering follow-up: we should split into 3 tickets: SDK-session, terraform-provisioner, marketplace-asset. SDK-session needs auth design doc (1 pager) before work. I'll pick up the terraform ticket.
intake-bot: Ticket created: INT-4829 (integ:customer-acme). Linked to CRM deal #ACME-2026. Tags: customer-request, revenue-blocker, sdk, terraform, marketplace.
sam: OK — next steps: anna write 1-pager by EOD tomorrow, mike draft docs sample, zoe to confirm prioritization with PM execs. @everyone please add estimates to INT-4829. :thumbsup:
